source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Development phase (PDF 8-9).

blocks.text: Development ke marhale mein software ka asal banna shuru hota hai. Programmers code likhte hain, yaani hidayaat ka majmooa jis par computer khaas kaam anjaam dene ke liye chalta hai. Design ki tafseelat (specifications) ki bunyad par, jo batati hain ke software ko kya karna aur kaisa dikhna hai, programmers in tafseelat ko programming language mein badalte hain.

Yeh recipe par chalne jaisa hai: design ki tafseelat recipe hain aur coding cake banane ke liye ajza milana aur pakana hai; code ki har line recipe ka ek qadam hai. Is marhale mein programmers apna code bhi test karte hain ta ke ghaltiyan ya bugs dhoond kar theek karein; masail milne par code badalte, theek karte aur dobara test karte hain jab tak software agle marhale ke liye tayyar na ho.

blocks.prompt: Development ke marhale mein programmers code likhne ke ilawa kya karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Woh apna code test karte hain, bugs dhoond kar theek karte hain, code badal kar dobara test karte hain jab tak woh design ke mutabiq kaam na kare aur testing ke marhale ke liye tayyar na ho.

items: Development: programmers design ki tafseelat ko programming language ke code mein badalte hain.
Recipe par chalne jaisa; woh agle marhale se pehle apna code test, theek aur dobara test bhi karte hain.
